license_required.quote: No person shall practice dentistry without first applying for and obtaining a license for such purpose from the Department.

name.quote: "Department" means the Department of Financial and Professional Regulation.

type.quote: "Department" means the Department of Financial and Professional Regulation.

age_minimum.quote: Be at least 21 years of age and of good moral character.

moral_character_required.quote: Be at least 21 years of age and of good moral character.

degree_required.value: Graduation from an approved dental college or school requiring at least 4 academic years of instruction
degree_required.quote: completion of at least 4 academic years of instruction or the equivalent in an approved dental college or school that is accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association
accrediting_body.quote: accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association

exams.name: National Board Dental Examination (integrated)
exams.notes: Administered by the Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations
exams.quote: passed the integrated National Board Dental Examination administered by the Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations

exams.name: Regional clinical examination (CRDTS, SRTA, WREB, CDCA, or CITA)
exams.notes: Applicant must successfully complete an examination conducted by one of the listed regional testing services
exams.quote: successfully completed an examination conducted by one of the following regional testing services: the Central Regional Dental Testing Service, Inc. (CRDTS), the Southern Regional Testing Agency, Inc. (SRTA), the Western Regional Examining Board (WREB), the Commission on Dental Competency Assessments (CDCA), or the Council of Interstate Testing Agencies (CITA)

interval_years.quote: The renewal period for each license issued under this Act shall be 3 years.

required.quote: the Department shall require a minimum of 48 hours of study in approved courses for dentists during each 3-year licensing period

hours_per_period.quote: a minimum of 48 hours of study in approved courses for dentists during each 3-year licensing period

available.quote: Any person who has been lawfully licensed to practice dentistry...in another state or territory...may, upon payment of the required fee, be granted a license to practice dentistry...in this State

requirements.value: Applicant must have been lawfully licensed in another state with substantially equivalent standards, actively practiced for at least 2 years immediately preceding application, and deposit a duly attested certificate from the other state's board. 'Substantially equivalent' means graduation from an ADA-accredited dental college, passage of both parts of the National Board Dental Examination, and completion of a regional testing service examination.
requirements.quote: who has been lawfully engaged in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene for at least 2 years immediately preceding the filing of his or her application to practice in this State and who shall deposit with the Department a duly attested certificate from the Board of the state or territory in which he or she is licensed

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice dentistry without first applying for and obtaining a license for such purpose from the Department.

credential_type.quote: The Department shall issue a license authorizing practice as a dentist to any person who qualifies for a license under this Act.

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice dentistry without first applying for and obtaining a license for such purpose from the Department.

title_protection.quote: No dentist shall announce or hold himself or herself out to the public as a specialist or as being specially qualified in any particular branch of dentistry unless he or she is licensed to practice in that specialty of dentistry.

scope_protection.quote: The practice of dentistry by any person not holding a valid and current license under this Act is declared to be inimical to the public welfare, to constitute a public nuisance, and to cause irreparable harm to the public welfare.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license, or in connection with renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license under this Act, or in connection with applying for renewal of a license under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety due to habitual or excessive use of alcohol, narcotics, or other chemical agents
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety as a result of habitual or excessive use or addiction to alcohol, narcotics, stimulants, or any other chemical agent or drug.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or repeated violations of the rules of the Department of Public Health or Department of Nuclear Safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or repeated violations of the rules of the Department of Public Health or Department of Nuclear Safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Division of fees or agreeing to split fees received for dental services with any person for bringing or referring a patient without the patient's knowledge
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Division of fees or agreeing to split or divide the fees received for dental services with any person for bringing or referring a patient...without the knowledge of the patient or his or her legal representative.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing, procuring, inducing, aiding or abetting a person not licensed as a dentist or dental hygienist to engage in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing, procuring, inducing, aiding or abetting a person not licensed or registered as a dentist or dental hygienist to engage in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making misrepresentations or false promises to influence, persuade or induce dental patronage
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any misrepresentations or false promises, directly or indirectly, to influence, persuade or induce dental patronage.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or seeking to obtain practice, money, or other things of value by false or fraudulent representations, including defrauding the medical assistance program
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or seeking to obtain practice, money, or any other things of value by false or fraudulent representations, but not limited to, engaging in such fraudulent practice to defraud the medical assistance program

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing under a false or assumed name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing under a false or, except as provided by law, an assumed name.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical, or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction for a felony under the laws of this State or a misdemeanor involving dishonesty or directly related to the practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction by plea of guilty or nolo contendere, finding of guilt, jury verdict, or entry of judgment or by sentencing for any crime...that (i) is a felony under the laws of this State or (ii) is a misdemeanor, an essential element of which is dishonesty, or that is directly related to the practice of dentistry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting a dental hygienist, dental assistant or other person under supervision to perform any operation not authorized by this Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting a dental hygienist, dental assistant or other person under his or her supervision to perform any operation not authorized by this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A violation of any provision of this Act or any rules promulgated under this Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of any provision of this Act or any rules promulgated under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of Section 45 relating to advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of Section 45 relating to advertising.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline by another U.S. jurisdiction or foreign nation for substantially equivalent grounds
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discipline by another U.S. jurisdiction or foreign nation, if at least one of the grounds for the discipline is the same or substantially equivalent to those set forth within this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failing to report an instance of suspected child abuse or neglect as required by the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully failing to report an instance of suspected child abuse or neglect as required by the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence in practice under this Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence in practice under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use or prescription of narcotics or controlled substances other than for therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use or prescription for use of narcotics or controlled substances or designated products as listed in the Illinois Controlled Substances Act, in any way other than for therapeutic purposes.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making or filing false records or reports in practice as a dentist
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully making or filing false records or reports in his or her practice as a dentist, including, but not limited to, false records to support claims against the dental assistance program

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional incompetence as manifested by poor standards of care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional incompetence as manifested by poor standards of care.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical or mental illness, including deterioration through aging or loss of motor skills, resulting in inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill or safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Physical or mental illness, including, but not limited to, deterioration through the aging process, or loss of motor skills which results in a dentist's inability to practice dentistry with reasonable judgment, skill or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross or repeated irregularities in billing for services rendered to a patient, including excessive charges, charges for services not rendered, or incorrect reporting of services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross or repeated irregularities in billing for services rendered to a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continuing active practice of dentistry while knowingly having any infectious, communicable, or contagious disease proscribed by rule
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Continuing the active practice of dentistry while knowingly having any infectious, communicable, or contagious disease proscribed by rule or regulation of the Department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being named as a perpetrator in an indicated report by DCFS upon proof by clear and convincing evidence of causing a child to be abused or neglected
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being named as a perpetrator in an indicated report by the Department of Children and Family Services pursuant to the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act, and upon proof by clear and convincing evidence that the licensee has caused a child to be an abused child or neglected child

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the Health Care Worker Self-Referral Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating the Health Care Worker Self-Referral Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment of a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment of a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental incompetency as declared by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mental incompetency as declared by a court of competent jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Finding that the licensee, after having license placed on probationary status, has violated the terms of probation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A finding by the Department that the licensee, after having his or her license placed on probationary status, has violated the terms of probation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Material misstatement in furnishing information to the Department
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Material misstatement in furnishing information to the Department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing within 60 days to provide information in response to a written request by the Department in the course of an investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing, within 60 days, to provide information in response to a written request by the Department in the course of an investigation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral conduct in the commission of any act, including commission of an act of sexual misconduct related to the licensee's practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Immoral conduct in the commission of any act, including, but not limited to, commission of an act of sexual misconduct related to the licensee's practice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the licensing examination administered under this Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the licensing examination administered under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A pattern of practice or other behavior that demonstrates incapacity or incompetence to practice under this Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A pattern of practice or other behavior that demonstrates incapacity or incompetence to practice under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to establish and maintain records of patient care and treatment as required under this Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to establish and maintain records of patient care and treatment as required under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide copies of dental records as required by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to provide copies of dental records as required by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a licensed dentist who owns or is employed at a dental office to give notice of an office closure to patients at least 30 days prior to closure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a licensed dentist who owns or is employed at a dental office to give notice of an office closure to his or her patients at least 30 days prior to the office closure pursuant to Section 50.1.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain a sanitary work environment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain a sanitary work environment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the provisions of Section 17.2 of this Act (teledentistry)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the provisions of Section 17.2 of this Act.

definition_quote.value: Dentistry means the healing art which is concerned with the examination, diagnosis, treatment planning, and care of conditions within the human oral cavity and its adjacent tissues and structures, as further specified in Section 17.
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" means the healing art which is concerned with the examination, diagnosis, treatment planning, and care of conditions within the human oral cavity and its adjacent tissues and structures, as further specified in Section 17.

value: diagnosis and treatment of diseases, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury, or physical condition of the human tooth, teeth, alveolar process, gums, or jaw
performing dental operations of any kind
use of X-Ray machines or X-Ray films for dental diagnostic purposes
extraction of human teeth or correction of malpositions of human teeth or jaws
diagnosis, treatment, or removal of stains, calculus, and bonding materials from human teeth or jaws
use or administration of local or general anesthetics in dental treatment
taking impressions or digital scans for replacement of teeth or associated tissues
furnishing, constructing, reproducing, or repairing prosthetic dentures, bridges, or other substitutes for natural teeth
methods_authorized.quote: Who represents himself or herself as being able to diagnose or diagnoses, treats, prescribes, or operates for any disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury, or physical condition of the human tooth, teeth, alveolar process, gums, or jaw

drug_authority.value: Dentists may use or administer local or general anesthetics in the treatment of dental or oral diseases or in any preparation incident to a dental operation; may dispense drugs or medicines in good faith; may prescribe controlled substances for therapeutic purposes
drug_authority.quote: Who uses or administers local or general anesthetics in the treatment of dental or oral diseases or in any preparation incident to a dental operation of any kind or character

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: No licensed dentist shall administer general anesthesia, deep sedation, or moderate sedation without first applying for and obtaining a permit for such purpose from the Department.

specialist_license_available.quote: The Department shall issue a license authorizing practice as a specialist in any particular branch of dentistry to any dentist who has complied with the requirements established for that particular branch of dentistry at the time of making application.

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: No dentist shall announce or hold himself or herself out to the public as a specialist or as being specially qualified in any particular branch of dentistry unless he or she is licensed to practice in that specialty of dentistry.

specialty_advertising_disclaimer_require.quote: any advertisement which announces the availability of endodontics, pediatric dentistry, periodontics, prosthodontics, orthodontics and dentofacial orthopedics, oral and maxillofacial surgery, or oral and maxillofacial radiology by a general dentist or by a licensed specialist who is not licensed in that specialty shall include a disclaimer stating that the dentist does not hold a license in that specialty.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Supervision" means supervision of a dental hygienist or a dental assistant requiring that a dentist authorize the procedure, remain in the dental facility while the procedure is performed, and approve the work performed..."General supervision" means supervision of a dental hygienist requiring that the patient be a patient of record..."Public health supervision" means the supervision of a public health dental hygienist by a licensed dentist who has a written public health supervision agreement

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: "Public health supervision" means the supervision of a public health dental hygienist by a licensed dentist who has a written public health supervision agreement with that public health dental hygienist

collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: A dentist entering into an agreement under this Section may supervise and enter into agreements for public health supervision with 4 public health dental hygienists.

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: "Public health dental hygienist" means a hygienist who holds a valid license to practice in the State, has 2 years of full-time clinical experience or an equivalent of 4,000 hours of clinical experience, and has completed at least 42 clock hours of additional structured courses in dental education in advanced areas specific to public health dentistry.

value: uninsured patients whose household income is not greater than 300% of the federal poverty level
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: allows the public health dental hygienist to treat patients, without a dentist first examining the patient and being present in the facility during treatment, (1) who are eligible for Medicaid or (2) who are uninsured or whose household income is not greater than 300% of the federal poverty level.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: No corporation shall practice dentistry or engage therein, or hold itself out as being entitled to practice dentistry, or furnish dental services or dentists

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Any dentist who employs or engages the services of any dental laboratory to construct or repair, extraorally, prosthetic dentures, bridges, or other replacements for a part of a tooth, a tooth, or teeth...shall furnish such dental laboratory with a written prescription on forms prescribed by the Department

denture_patient_identification_marking_r.quote: Every complete upper and lower denture and removable dental prosthesis fabricated by a dentist, or fabricated pursuant to his or her prescription, shall be marked with the name of the patient for whom the prosthesis is intended.

teledentistry_authorized.quote: "Teledentistry" means the use of telehealth systems and methodologies in dentistry and includes patient care and education delivery using synchronous and asynchronous communications under a dentist's authority as provided under this Act.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: administration of local anesthetics upon successful completion of a training program approved by the Department

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: administration and monitoring of nitrous oxide upon successful completion of a training program approved by the Department

restorative_function_endorsement_availab.quote: a dental hygienist may engage in the placing, carving, and finishing of amalgam restorations only after obtaining formal education and certification as determined by the Department

interim_therapeutic_restoration_authoriz.quote: A dental assistant may place, carve, and finish amalgam restorations, place, pack, and finish composite restorations, and place interim restorations if he or she (A) has successfully completed a structured training program

patient_record_retention_years.quote: Dental records required by this Section shall be maintained for 10 years.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: ensure that the dentist has completed and maintains current certification in advanced cardiac life support or pediatric advanced life support and all persons assisting the dentist or monitoring the administration of general anesthesia, deep sedation, or moderate sedation maintain current certification in Basic Life Support (BLS)

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: "Public health dental hygienist" means a hygienist who holds a valid license to practice in the State, has 2 years of full-time clinical experience or an equivalent of 4,000 hours of clinical experience, and has completed at least 42 clock hours of additional structured courses in dental education in advanced areas specific to public health dentistry.
